description: 对手叠上反应层数那么多层【燃血】：治疗无效，N 层就每秒受到 N 点火焰伤害、持续 N 秒（层数不掉），再反应就加层加秒。

descriptions.en: The opponent gains Seared Blood equal to the reaction stacks: healing does nothing, and with N stacks they take N Fire damage each second for N seconds (stacks don't drop); reacting again adds stacks and seconds.
